*Last updated November 11, 2026.*

## This site

This site has no analytics, cookies or tracking scripts. It is hosted on GitHub Pages, which
keeps standard server logs, including IP addresses, under
[GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Map apps

The Earth Engine map apps linked from my project pages open without sign-in and collect
nothing about you. Google runs them under its
[privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

## Google API client

I run a Google OAuth client, "rclone-yggdrasil", for my own use only: it backs up files from
my workstation to my own Google Drive. It is not offered to anyone else. It reads and writes
only the Drive of the account that signs in to it, which is mine. That data moves only between
my computer and my Drive; it is not shared, sold, or used to train AI models.

Use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the
[Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy),
including the Limited Use requirements.

Questions: see the [contact page](/contact.html).
